function.name: add_transaction
function.description: Log money the user spent or received (one-off). Use for 'I spent $12 at Chipotle', 'got paid $200 by Sam'. Amounts are positive; use type='income' for money received. Date defaults to today and accepts 'yesterday', 'last friday', 'Nov 3' or YYYY-MM-DD. Category is guessed from the merchant if omitted. Read the returned message back to the user.

merchant.description: Who was paid or who paid (e.g. 'Trader Joe's', 'Sam')

category.description: e.g. Groceries, Dining, Gas, Transport, Shopping, Coffee, Health, Fun, Housing, Utilities, Paycheck

account.description: Account name if the user said one (e.g. 'Chase checking')

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed an amount over $5,000

allow_duplicate.description: Set true if the user really made the same purchase twice in a few minutes

function.name: save_recurring
function.description: Add or update a recurring bill (money out) or payout (money in), e.g. rent, phone bill, subscriptions, paychecks. If an item with the same name (or recurring_id) exists it is updated with only the fields given; otherwise a new one is created (name, amount and cadence required).

recurring_id.description: Id of an existing item to update (from list_options/list_upcoming)

kind.description: bill = money out (default), payout = money in

next_date.description: Next (or first) due date; sets the day of month for monthly items

end_date.description: Optional last date; null to clear

confirm.description: Set true only after the user confirmed an amount over $5,000

function.name: mark_paid
function.description: Mark a scheduled bill as paid (or a payout as received). Without a date it marks the oldest unpaid occurrence (overdue first, else the next one due within 10 days). Pass amount if it differed from usual.

date.description: Which due date (occurrence) this pays, optional

paid_date.description: When it was actually paid, if different from the due date

function.name: list_upcoming
function.description: Bills and payouts due in the next N days, plus anything overdue, with paid status and totals.

function.name: month_summary
function.description: Income, spending, net, spending by category, top merchants and balances for a month (default this month).

month.description: YYYY-MM or a month name like 'October'

function.name: search_transactions
function.description: Find transactions by text, category, date range or amount. Returns newest first (max 100).

source.description: e.g. 'arturo' to see only what the assistant added

function.name: list_options
function.description: Existing categories, accounts and recurring items (with ids and next due dates). Call before guessing names.

function.name: undo_last_action
function.description: Undo the most recent change this assistant made (or a specific action_id): deletes what it added or restores what it changed.

action_id.description: Optional: a specific action to undo
